verdict.rationale: Codex supports signing in with a ChatGPT Business/Enterprise/Edu account (codex-gh-3, codex-gh-7) and OpenAI's platform offers RBAC to scope access at org/project level (codex-docs-28), suggesting enterprise-grade authentication and access control exist. However, there is no explicit documentation of SSO/SAML/OIDC federation with enterprise identity providers (e.g., Okta, Azure AD) specific to Codex, nor details on how ChatGPT Enterprise auth ties into RBAC for Codex usage. Missing for 10: explicit SSO/SAML/OIDC integration docs, enterprise IdP federation details, and independent confirmation of compliance-grade auth flows for Codex specifically.
